description: This file defines the CalendarAccountEventFactory class, responsible for creating CalendarAccountEvent objects from various sources such as beans (Meetings, Calls, Tasks) and other event data. It handles parsing dates, setting event types, and establishing relationships within a SuiteCRM context.

classes.name: CalendarAccountEventFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating CalendarAccountEvent instances from beans, sources, and data, used within SuiteCRM to synchronize calendar events.

methods.name: fromMeetingBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Meeting bean and a CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromBean
methods.description: Converts a generic bean (Meeting, Call, Task) into a CalendarAccountEvent, parsing dates and setting event type accordingly.

methods.name: fromCallBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Call bean and a CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromTaskBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Task bean and a CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromSourceEvent
methods.description: Creates a new CalendarAccountEvent from an existing event, assigning a new event ID.

methods.name: parseDateTimeString
methods.description: Parses a date string into a SugarDateTime object, checking various formats.
